# BMD Compute v1 contract fixtures

Generated by `generate_from_compute.py` from BMD Compute's own producer code
(read-only import of a clean checkout), so Agent's tests read real Compute v1
output without a Compute checkout at test time. BMD Compute owns every
contract represented here; Agent adds no scientific content.

| File | Compute producer | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `capabilities.json` | `backend.calculations.capabilities.build_capability_payload` | capability payload `schema_version` 1, including additive `stage_modifier_support` |
| `desired_output_nio/submission.json` | `main.build_submission_state_from_structure` with `resolve_default_treatments` (Desired Output `energy_only`) | `bmd_compute.submission` v1 with `runtime_parity`, `paths.runtime_environment`, and provenance v1 `execution.automatic_treatments` (spin polarisation and automatic DFT+U) |
| `custom_workflow_nio/submission.json` | `main.build_submission_state_from_structure` with an explicit workflow | `bmd_compute.submission` v1; no automatic-treatment record |
| `runtime_environment_passed.json` | `backend.runtime_environment.enforce_runtime_environment` | `bmd_compute.runtime_environment` v1, `status` `passed` |
| `runtime_environment_failed.json` | `enforce_runtime_environment` with a drifted `pymatgen-core` and a non-empty `VASP_INCAR_UPDATES` | `bmd_compute.runtime_environment` v1, `status` `failed` with Compute's problems |

Normalizations are listed in the generator docstring (timestamps, host, the
atomate2 `CONFIG_FILE` home path, SLURM job ID, fixture identity secret). None
changes scientific content or Compute's verdicts.

## Identity

`SHA256SUMS` lists the SHA-256 of every fixture file and is the fixtures'
identity; Agent's tests verify it.

## Generation provenance

- BMD Compute v1.0.0, commit `a746155b487f903a167eca6b3c92e860aaf8c7f5`, clean
  (recorded in `capabilities.json` `source` and in each submission's
  `provenance.bmd_compute.source`).
- Python 3.12 with exactly `constraints/scientific-runtime.txt` installed.

This is provenance, not identity. BMD Compute's own canonical run-record
fixtures (`tests/fixtures/compute_run_records/`, vendored byte-for-byte) predate
runtime parity and automatic-treatment records; Agent uses them as historical
v1 records. These fixtures cover the newer additive v1 fields.

Regenerate only when the represented Compute contracts or outputs change:

    BMD_SUBMISSION_IDENTITY_SECRET=fixture-only PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
        python -B generate_from_compute.py <bmd_compute checkout> <this directory>
